message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Short-Term Insider Purchase Ratio", "construction": "Number of shares purchased by corporate insiders over the past 3 months divided by total shares outstanding, using Form 4 filings.", "rationale": "Recent insider purchases may signal undervaluation and superior information about the firm’s near-term prospects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Inventory Growth Volatility", "construction": "Standard deviation of quarterly percentage changes in inventory over the past 3 years, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "High volatility in inventory growth may reflect uncertainty in demand forecasting or operational inefficiency, potentially linked to mispricing.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D Capitalization Ratio", "construction": "Current R&D expense (Compustat item XRDQ) divided by the average of the past 3 years’ capital expenditures (CAPX), for firms with nonzero R&D.", "rationale": "Firms investing more in intangible innovation relative to tangible assets may be undervalued if markets underappreciate future growth from R&D.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Delayed Analyst Coverage", "construction": "Number of days between fiscal year-end and first analyst forecast update (IBES), measured for the most recent fiscal year.", "rationale": "Longer delays may indicate neglect or lack of attention, possibly leading to mispricing due to information diffusion effects.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Supplier Concentration Exposure", "construction": "Sum of top 3 supplier purchase percentages as disclosed in 10-K filings, for firms that report supplier concentration.", "rationale": "High supplier concentration may involve operational risk, with potential for under- or over-valuation depending on market recognition.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Earnings Season Return Drift", "construction": "Cumulative return from the day after earnings announcement to 20 trading days after, over the past 4 quarters.", "rationale": "Persistent post-announcement drift may reveal investor inattention or slow information incorporation.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Capital Raise Discount", "construction": "Percentage discount of recent (past year) secondary equity issue price to pre-announcement market price.", "rationale": "A greater discount may reflect adverse selection or desperation to raise capital, implicating future underperformance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Change Consistency", "construction": "Number of consecutive quarters with unchanged dividend per share, capped at 8.", "rationale": "Long streaks of unchanged dividends may signal conservatism and stable management, which could be underappreciated by the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Geographic Expansion", "construction": "Growth in number of countries reported as sales destinations in annual 10-K, current year minus previous year.", "rationale": "Firms expanding geographically may achieve higher growth and diversification benefits that are not fully priced in.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Citation Intensity", "construction": "Number of forward citations to patents granted to the firm in the past 5 years, normalized by total patents granted (USPTO data).", "rationale": "High citation intensity may signal technological leadership and future cash flow growth not fully incorporated by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
